candidate_selection.exclusions: punctuation-only, whitespace-only, special/EOS, padded non-tokenizer IDs; symbols/byte artifacts retained but flagged

validation.min_variant_consistency: same sign in all five modes
validation.multiple_testing: 10,000 independent passage-level circular phase rotations; max absolute studentized statistic across all frozen token-phase candidates; FWER .05

record_models.fit: discovery sets only; heldout MSE compared within heldout sets; resample sets for uncertainty
record_models.boundary: last separator token; secondary end/end+1 window predefined

analysis_note: Raw LP ratios reported; conditional-content LP ratio removes mass competition from punctuation. No claim of training-data reconstruction.
